data.name: NF-κB
data.description: Master pro-inflammatory transcription factor complex that cross-talks extensively with PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling.
data.description_beginner: The cell's main inflammation switch: a protein complex that, once released, moves into the nucleus and turns on hundreds of immune genes. It talks back and forth constantly with the PI3K/AKT/mTOR growth pathway.
